newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Chandrika Kumaratunga's visit to South Korea last year has generated tremendous enthusiasm and opened doors for Korean industrial giants like Hanjung, Hyundai, Daewoo, Samsung and Goldstar to invest in Sri Lanka, senior Board of Investment official says.
Kumaratunga says foremost objective in new year is to achieve peace and rebuild the war-ravaged nation.
Police arrest suspected mastermind behind recent hashish smuggling. Police detected more than 10,000 kilograms of the banned drug in a coastal town north of Colombo.
Security forces launch two limited operations in north and east to destroy separatist Tamil Tiger guerrillas.
Forces carry out air and land strikes at rebel positions in the east.
Security forces advance on rebel positions in east, despite heavy rain and separtist landmines.
